sources.entry: NotchDeck - Control center around the MacBook notch with system metrics, media controls, quick notes, screen recording and task profiles. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/systemAdmin-ai/NotchDeck) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: NotchDeck is a free, MIT-licensed macOS app that turns the area around the MacBook notch into a hover-activated control panel for system metrics, app shortcuts, notes, screen recording and media controls.
use_cases: monitor CPU, memory and other system stats from the notch
record the screen with microphone or system audio
take screenshots saved to a chosen folder
switch between task profiles with different app and button layouts
control now-playing media from a compact view
keep quick notes accessible from the menu bar area
remap keys on external keyboards from a Mac
how_to_run: Download NotchDeck-<version>-AppleSilicon.dmg from the latest release, drag NotchDeck.app into Applications, and launch it
notable: Hover over the notch to open a panel with metrics, app shortcuts, notes and recording, with eight themes
Optional permissions replace the system brightness and volume HUD and enable screenshots, recording and voice
Clipboard history is opt-in, memory-only and cleared on exit; no telemetry or cloud sync
Interface available in English and Russian, switchable without relaunching
Releases ship SHA256SUMS.txt and a minisign signature, plus GitHub attestation verification
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) and macOS 14 or newer; Intel is unsupported
App is signed with a local certificate, not notarized, so first launch may be blocked and need manual approval in System Settings
Some media features use a private macOS API and may break after OS updates
Keyboard mode is a 2.1 development preview not present in the linked release
